    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Application
    Main class to start the web server application.
    Barrel
    Implementation of the Index barrel remote interface.
    BarrelInterface
    Remote interface for the distributed index server.
    Client
    Console for the Gateway RMI server.
    ClientService
    Client Service class to interact with Gateway.
    Config
    Ports management class.
    Database
    Database Class for Barrels Management and Connection
    Downloader
    Downloader for fetching and processing web pages.
    ErrorController
    Custom Error Controller to handle errors.
    FooterController
    Footer Controller to handle footer links.
    Gateway
    Implementation of the GatewayInterface for clients.
    GatewayInterface
    Remote interface for the Gateway for clients.
    IndexController
    Index Controller to handle indexing requests.
    Log
    Debug utility class.
    Page
    Class representing page information including URL, title, and snippet.
    ResultsController
    Results Controller to handle search results and backlinks.
    SearchController
    Search Controller to handle search page and redirection.
    StartupManager
    Startup Manager to initialize components on application start.
    Stats
    Statistics collector for search queries and barrel performance.
    StatsController
    Stats Controller to handle statistics page.
    StatsWebSocket
    WebSocket server for broadcasting stats to connected clients.
    UrlQueue
    Implementation of the UrlQueueInterface for managing a queue of URLs.
    UrlQueueInterface
    Remote interface for a distributed URL queue.
